pin.phoneLabel: Go and see Archie about the vein

cards.label: Whitechapel — behind the old brewery
cards.text: The vein is exactly where the pin said: a hairline crack in old brick, humming faintly at a frequency you'd ignore if you didn't already know what you were listening for. Archie's waiting with his hands in his pockets, doing an impression of a man who has never once stood around looking impatient.

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "Right. It's yours now, so you should know how it actually works, not just what the app tells you."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "See that number on it? Growth. Runs nought to a hundred, dead centre at fifty. Leave it be and it drifts — climbs if it was already climbing, sinks if it was already sinking. Doesn't just sit there, whatever you do."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "Cultivate pushes it up. Put a session in — might take, might not, that part's down to your own skill. Land it low and it jumps a fair way; land it near the top and you're barely nudging it. Miss, and you've lost nothing but the time."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "Prune's how the calc actually comes out, and it only pays once you're past fifty. Light prune takes a bit, leaves the rest growing. Hard prune takes more, sets it right back — more calc for your trouble, mind."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "Run one all the way down and leave it there, and it won't wait patient for you — spent long enough, it just collapses and disappears on you. The patch stays, mind, ready to seed again — it's the vein you lose."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "So don't get greedy on something you can't afford to lose. Go on, then — put a session in. I'll watch, so you don't feel like you're talking to brick."

You work the vein the way he showed you. It takes, first go — beginner's luck, or possibly just Archie standing close enough to make failure socially awkward. The growth number ticks up. Somewhere under Whitechapel, something that used to belong to someone else settles into belonging to you.

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "There. Not complicated. Keep at it, and don't tell anyone else where it is."

on_complete.text: Come by the lock-up. Got someone you need to meet. Don't make a thing of it.
